assertion: Foreground blending happens against the filtered backdrop before clip, alpha mask and group opacity. Full/half/zero opacity controls retain identical clip boundaries.

browser.reason: Reviewed PNGs and difference images. Chrome preserves the filtered backdrop and applies foreground blending before final source-over; Firefox/WebKit captures omit invert even in the standalone control in this environment. See ../backdrop-blend/README.md. Only one output channel level differs across 4400 translucent pixels; geometry and opaque regions were reviewed.
